@graph.description: This demonstration showcases our Python library’s Containernet backend by reproducing a published post-quantum TLS measurement. We reconstructed the topology in YANG from the original publication’s text and diagrams. It connects a client and server through a bidirectional link, with optical splitters directing traffic to a sniffer. The backend instantiates this topology and emulates it with the optical splitters. Scripts from the original public artifacts install the software dependencies and execute the measurement reported in Table 4a of “The Performance of Post-Quantum TLS 1.3” (DOI: 10.1145/3624354.3630585) by Sosnowski et al., presented at CoNEXT’23. The table lists median handshake latencies for different key encapsulation mechanisms (KEMs) under varying network conditions. Finally, the results are evaluated, a CSV file and a PDF plot are generated, and the emulation is stopped.
@graph.name: Demonstration of the YANG Topology Emulation in Containernet: Reproduction of a Post-Quantum TLS Performance Measurement
